```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
require(rENA);
library(rENA);
library(rstudioapi)
library(tidyverse)
# Select the directory containing the tma script, like the directory above^
# setwd(selectDirectory())
devtools::load_all(".")
data = read.csv(system.file(package = "tma", 'extdata/TADMUSCoded.csv'), stringsAsFactors = FALSE);
# d = read.csv('./TADMUSCoded.csv')
data = data %>% 
  group_by(Team, Scenario, TimeImputed) %>% 
  mutate(average_secs = 
           case_when(
             str_detect(TimeImputed, '-') ~ 60/n(),
             TRUE ~ 30/n()
           )
    ) %>% 
  group_by(Team, Scenario) %>% 
  mutate(time_secs = cumsum(average_secs)) %>% ungroup
mean_time = data[,c('average_secs')] %>% t %>% as.vector %>% mean
data = data %>% group_by(Team, Scenario) %>% mutate(time = 1:n())
# Subset data so that it can 
data = data[data$Team == '4/1/99' & data$Scenario == 'Bravo',];
# Subset even further so we can manually check by hand
data  = data[1:30,];

code_cols = c(
  "SeekingInformation", 
  "DetectIdentify",
  "TrackBehavior",
  "StatusUpdate",
  "AssessmentPrioritization",
  "DefensiveOrders",
  "DeterrentOrders",
  "Recommendation"
)
speaker_units = c('COND', 'Team', 'MacroRole', 'Speaker');
meta = c('MacroRole');
conversation = c('Team', 'Scenario');

accum = ena.accumulate.data(
  units = data[,speaker_units],
  conversation = data[,conversation],
  codes = data[,code_cols],
  window.size.back = 5,
  # weight.by = function(x) {return(ifelse(x>0,1,0))}
  weight.by = function(x) {return(x)}
)

ena_cc = accum$connection.counts[accum$connection.counts$MacroRole!='Other'];
ena_cc = ena_cc[,2:33];

# TMA

my.hoo.usualENA = list();
my.hoo.usualENA[[1]] = list(Team = "<UNIT>", Scenario = "<UNIT>");
my.units = unique(data[,speaker_units]);
# hoos.regular = get.contexts(units = my.units, data = d, hoo.rules = my.hoo.usualENA);
modal.decay.function = list()
modal.decay.function$Bravo = continuous.decay.function.convex;
modal.decay.function$Bravo = step_function(5);

devtools::load_all(".")
tma_accumulation = tma(
  data = data,
  units = my.units,
  codes = code_cols,
  hoo.rules = my.hoo.usualENA,
  # weight.by = function(x) {return(ifelse(x>0,1,0))},
  weight.by = function(x) {x},
  return.ena.set = TRUE,
  time.column = NA,
  decay.function = modal.decay.function,
  mode.column = 'Scenario',
  time.limit = NA,
  meta.data = NA
)

tma_cc = tma_accumulation$ena.set$connection.counts[tma_accumulation$ena.set$connection.counts$MacroRole != 'Other']
```
